Owners seeking **brand affiliation without sacrificing the hotel’s identity** generally consider a **soft brand or collection brand**. The most common CALA shortlists include:

| Hotel group | Collection brands commonly considered | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upper-upscale; among the most established choices for independent resorts and distinctive urban hotels. Marriott specifically positions these collections as an operating model for independent properties. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** | LXR for luxury, Curio for upper-upscale/luxury lifestyle, and Tapestry for upscale boutiques. Hilton emphasizes flexible frameworks that retain each property’s story while providing Hilton distribution, technology and Honors. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Luxury and upper-upscale independent hotels with strong narratives. The collection is expanding in the Caribbean, including Cayo Levantado Resort in the Dominican Republic. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/UnboundAnniversaryGrowth2026?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | Luxury independent hotels that retain their name, identity and operating character while joining IHG’s commercial platform. Vignette is actively expanding in Latin America and the Caribbean. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/our-brands/vignette?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection** | Luxury, upper-upscale and upscale/midscale, respectively. These are designed around flexible standards and preservation of the owner’s concept; MGallery already has a presence in markets such as Brazil. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** | Registry for luxury resorts and Trademark for upper-midscale through upscale independent hotels. Registry has particular relevance for Mexican and Caribbean resort or all-inclusive properties. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**, **Radisson Individuals** | Ascend for upscale boutique, historic and resort properties; Radisson Individuals for upper-upscale full-service hotels. Both emphasize fewer design constraints than conventional brands. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **WorldHotels**, **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection** | Often considered by smaller independent resorts and established family-owned hotels seeking lighter-touch affiliation and broad distribution. These collections are promoted as allowing owners to maintain their identity and culture. ([caribjournal.com](https://www.caribjournal.com/2022/02/16/best-western-ceo-larry-cuculic-caribbean-market/?utm_source=openai)) |

### Most likely first-round shortlist

For a distinctive **upper-upscale or luxury Caribbean/Latin American resort**, the names most frequently evaluated would usually be:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **The Luxury Collection**
3. **Curio Collection**
4. **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
5. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
6. **Vignette Collection**
7. **MGallery Collection**
8. **Registry Collection Hotels**

For an **upscale boutique or conversion**, add:

- **Tribute Portfolio**
- **Tapestry Collection**
- **Trademark Collection**
- **Ascend Hotel Collection**
- **Handwritten Collection**
- **Radisson Individuals**

Owners wanting even more independence may also examine **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** or **The Leading Hotels of the World**. These are membership/representation platforms rather than conventional franchise flags and therefore can preserve still more operating and visual autonomy; LHW is specifically structured around helping luxury hotels remain independent. ([lhw.com](https://www.lhw.com/corporate/about-us?utm_source=openai))

The ultimate comparison should examine not only royalty fees, but also reservation and loyalty charges, required property improvements, all-inclusive capability, owner naming rights, territorial protections, management requirements and how much control remains over design, food and beverage, staffing and local programming.
